name: Monitrax Neomatrix — financial logic knowledge graph
generatedNote: Layer 1 (semantic graph) — the canonical model. Hand-verified per CLAUDE.md §19.2; every `verified` node/edge cites file:line read in source. Markdown views render FROM this file (do not hand-edit the generated md). Phase 53 N1 core slice + N4.1 income-tax spine + N4.2 reform CGT/neg-gearing + tax domain + health + CFO (score + what-if) + intelligence + reports (property portfolio). All 6 domains represented.

nodes.label: Master financial snapshot
nodes.produces: The single financial snapshot: totals, expense/income breakdowns, cashflow (declared), quickMetrics (incl. actual* fields), emergency fund, health score, net worth, debt.
nodes.formula: Composition root — fetches raw rows, calls the pure engines, assembles one snapshot. computeMasterFinancialSnapshot() at :1752.

nodes.label: Net worth
nodes.produces: netWorth + asset summary (properties/accounts/investments/super/personalAssets/total), liability summary (mortgages/personalLoans/creditCards/total), breakdown (propertyEquity/liquidAssets/investmentAssets).
nodes.formula: assets.total = Σ property.currentValue + Σ account.currentBalance + Σ(units×price) + Σ super.balance[non-SMSF] + Σ asset.currentValue; liabilities.total = Σ loan.principal; netWorth = assets.total − liabilities.total.
nodes.authority: Accounting identity: net worth = total assets − total liabilities.

inputs.name: account.currentBalance
inputs.note: OFFSET counted as asset but excluded from liquidAssets

inputs.name: investment.units × (currentPrice ?? averagePrice)
inputs.note: market value; falls back to avg price

nodes.label: Holding market value (canonical helper)
nodes.produces: Market value of one investment holding = units × (currentPrice || averagePrice). The §12.2 read-model SSOT mirroring netWorthCalculator.
nodes.formula: value = Number(units||0) × Number(currentPrice||averagePrice||0). Float path: 0 is falsy so a 0 currentPrice falls back to averagePrice (matches the live net-worth engine, audit L1-5).

inputs.name: currentPrice||averagePrice
inputs.note: live price preferred; cost-basis fallback; 0 is falsy (||)

nodes.label: Loan current balance (canonical helper)
nodes.produces: Current outstanding loan balance = principal ?? currentBalance ?? balance. The §12.2 read-model SSOT mirroring netWorthCalculator.
nodes.formula: balance = Number(principal ?? currentBalance ?? balance ?? 0). Loan.principal IS the current balance (prisma schema), not the original face amount.
nodes.authority: lib/calculations/netWorthCalculator.ts calculateTotalLiabilities — Number(loan.principal||0); prisma schema: Loan.principal = current balance

inputs.name: principal
inputs.note: schema: IS current balance; nullish-coalesced with currentBalance/balance aliases for mapped shapes

nodes.label: NetWorthSnapshot (stored monthly)
nodes.produces: One stored row per (userId, calendar month): snapshotDate, totalAssets, totalLiabilities, netWorth. Recorded each dashboard load by netWorthSnapshotRecorder from the canonical net-worth engine output.

nodes.label: Net-worth history trend (honest, from stored snapshots)
nodes.produces: NetWorthHistoryResult — trend[] (oldest→newest, literal stored rows), deltaAbsolute, deltaPct. The §12.2 single canonical reader of NetWorthSnapshot.
nodes.formula: Honesty gate: <2 rows → { trend:[], deltaAbsolute:0, deltaPct:0 } (never fabricates a curve). Else deltaAbsolute = last.netWorth − first.netWorth; deltaPct = first!==0 ? round((deltaAbsolute / |first.netWorth|) × 1000)/10 : 0 (one-decimal %, abs baseline, no divide-by-zero).
nodes.authority: CLAUDE.md §0 financial-adviser lens (honesty: never invent data) + §12.2 SSOT
nodes.workedExample: rows [100k,120k]→ΔAbs +20,000, Δ% +20.0; 1 row→honesty gate empty; first 0→Δ% 0; [-10k,-5k]→ΔAbs +5,000, Δ% +50.0 (abs baseline)

nodes.label: Net-worth trend Δ / Δ% (displayed)
nodes.produces: The displayed net-worth trend change (absolute + percent) on the editorial Net Worth Trend tile.
nodes.formula: = getNetWorthHistory(...).{ deltaAbsolute, deltaPct }

nodes.label: Dashboard — Net Worth Trend tile
nodes.produces: Renders the monthly net-worth trend chart; quiet empty state when <2 months of data.

nodes.label: Per-entity position breakdown (additive view)
nodes.produces: EntityPosition[] — per owning-entity netWorth/assets/liabilities/monthlyIncome/expenses/cashflow. ADDITIVE: only adds the byEntity view beside the flat household numbers.
nodes.formula: Partition rows by ownerEntityId (null → __unattributed__ bucket, never dropped); per partition reuse calculateNetWorth (identical math) + Σ toMonthly(income/expenses); monthlyCashflow = monthlyIncome − monthlyExpenses. Invariant: Σ per-entity netWorth == household netWorth. Empty entities omitted; sort largest-net first, unattributed last.
nodes.authority: Phase 47 Stage C1 additivity contract (Σ per-entity == household) + §12.2/§12.3 (reuse calculateNetWorth, never re-implement)
nodes.workedExample: e1 (prop 800k, loan 600k) netWorth 200k, income 10k/mo − exp 3k/mo = cashflow 7k; e2 (cash 20k) netWorth 20k; Σ = 220k = household; null-owned 50k → Unattributed bucket

nodes.label: Money Story 12-month trend (earned vs spent)
nodes.produces: MoneyStoryTrendResult — per-month RibbonPoint{spent, kept}, currentMargin, baselineMargin, marginDeltaPoints, monthly earned/spent/netCashflow series + KPI deltas. Powers the Money Story v2 hero + KPI sparklines.
nodes.formula: Bucket transactions by YYYY-MM (IN→earned, OUT→+|amount| spent); kept = max(0, round(earned−spent)); currentMargin = round(last.kept/lastEarned×100) (lastEarned = kept+spent); incomeDeltaPct = round((earnedLast−earnedFirst)/earnedFirst×1000)/10; cashflowDeltaMonthly = last−prev month net; outgoingsDeltaVsAvg = round(lastSpent − windowAvg). Honesty gate: <2 months with activity → empty.
nodes.authority: CLAUDE.md §0 financial-adviser honesty contract (never invent data; zero months render zero, never interpolated) + §19.1 (actual transactions)

nodes.label: Declared cashflow
nodes.produces: CashflowResult — monthly/annual gross+net income, PAYG, expenses, loan repayments, cashflow (surplus), ratios (savingsRate/expenseRatio/debtServiceRatio), essential/discretionary split. DECLARED basis (records × frequency), NOT actual bank spend.
nodes.formula: monthlyCashflow = monthlyNetIncome − monthlyExpenses − monthlyLoanRepayments (NET income, after-tax); savingsRate = monthlyCashflow / monthlyNetIncome × 100 (0 when income ≤ 0).
nodes.authority: CLAUDE.md §19.1 (declared = the 'plan' side; fallback only when no transactions)

inputs.name: income.amount + frequency + salaryType

nodes.label: Actual cashflow
nodes.produces: ActualCashflowResult — current-month outflow/inflow/net, trailing-avg monthly outflow+inflow, current-month outflow-by-category (incl. 'Uncategorised'), hasActualData. From actual UnifiedTransaction rows.
nodes.formula: currentMonthOutflow = Σ|amount| over non-transfer OUT rows in current calendar month; net = inflow − outflow; avgMonthlyOutflow = Σ trailing OUT / (count of the prior 3 months that have ≥1 non-transfer txn) [data-driven divisor, floored at 1].

inputs.name: transaction.direction
inputs.note: IN/OUT decided by direction, NOT sign of amount

nodes.workedExample: Mar 10 + May 600 both populated, Apr empty → divisor 2 → avg 305 (a month with no txns is missing data, excluded from sum AND divisor)

nodes.label: Canonical monthly cashflow
nodes.produces: CanonicalMonthlyCashflow { inflow, outflow, net, savingsRate, avgMonthlyOutflow, basis } where basis ∈ {actual, declared}. THE SSOT for 'money in/out/net this month'.
nodes.formula: if hasActualData: {inflow,outflow,net} = actual, basis='actual'; else inflow=monthlyNetIncome, outflow=monthlyExpenses+monthlyLoanRepayments, net=monthlyCashflow, basis='declared'. savingsRate = net/inflow×100 (0 when inflow ≤ 0). outflow always includes loan repayments.
nodes.workedExample: In 25,827 / Out 46,741 → net −20,914; savingsRate ≈ −80.98%; basis 'actual' (the real deficit the old declared hero hid as +$10,505 / 51.9%)

nodes.produces: The pure actuals-vs-declared resolution (actual, declared) → canonical result. For routes that compute actuals locally.

nodes.label: State land tax (per state)
nodes.produces: Per-state land tax payable.
nodes.formula: generalLandTax = value≥generalThreshold ? applyBrackets(value): 0; applyBrackets: bracket where value≤max, inBracket = value − min + 1, tax = baseAmount + max(0,inBracket) × rate. NSW trust surcharge (non-fixed): min(value, $1.075M) × 0.015. Foreign surcharge: isForeignOwner && rate>0 && (!residentialOnly || isResidential) → value × rate. totalTax = general + trust + foreign.
nodes.authority: State Land Tax Acts (NSW 1956 / VIC 2005 / QLD / SA / WA / TAS)
nodes.verifiedBy: tests/neomatrix/financialAudit.test.ts (A1 law-referenced, NSW Land Tax Act 1956 s27/s5A/Sch1A) + lib/tax-engine/landTax/stateLandTax.ts:374
nodes.workedExample: NSW CY2025: $1.0M (<threshold)→$0; $2.0M→general $14,900 (100 + 925,000×0.016); trust $2M→surcharge $16,125 (1.5%×$1.075M); foreign residential $2M→surcharge $80,000 (×0.04), total $94,900; foreign non-residential→$0 (residential-only)

nodes.formula: generalDuty = applyBrackets(dutiableValue): find bracket where value≤max, inBracket = value − min + 1 (the +1 reflects the "duty per $1 of value" convention), duty = baseAmount + max(0,inBracket) × rate. FPAD: isForeignPurchaser && isResidential && surchargeRate>0 → dutiableValue × rate. totalDuty = generalDuty + FPAD.

nodes.label: Income tax (marginal brackets)
nodes.produces: IncomeTaxResult { taxPayable, marginalRate, effectiveRate }.
nodes.formula: Progressive marginal-bracket tax: find the bracket where taxableIncome falls; tax = bracket.baseAmount + (taxableIncome − bracket.min + 1) × bracket.rate. taxableIncome ≤ 0 → 0. P0 fix 2026-06-23: strict `<` on bracket.min so an income exactly at a bracket minimum is taxed (was returning $0 at every boundary).
nodes.authority: ITAA 1997; ATO individual income tax rates (FY24-25 Stage 3)

nodes.label: Low Income Tax Offset (LITO) — two-tier phase-out
nodes.produces: LITO offset (AUD) for FY24-25 — a non-refundable offset that reduces income tax.
nodes.formula: ≤0 → 0; ≤fullThreshold(37,500) → maxOffset(700); ≥cutoff(66,667) → 0; else reduction = min(income,45,000−37,500)×0.05 + (income−45,000)×0.015 (tier2 only when income>45,000); offset = round(max(0, 700 − reduction), 2).
nodes.authority: ATO Individual income tax rates — LITO FY24-25 (two-tier: 5c/$ 37.5k–45k, 1.5c/$ 45k–66,667)

nodes.label: Apply offsets to gross tax (refundable vs non-refundable)
nodes.produces: netTax + refundableAmount + usedOffsets — applies offsets to gross tax.
nodes.formula: Non-refundable (LITO+SAPTO+foreignTax+other) reduce tax only to $0: nonRefundableUsed = min(Σnon-refundable, grossTax); taxAfterNonRefundable = grossTax − nonRefundableUsed; netTax = taxAfterNonRefundable − frankingCredits (refundable → can go negative); refundableAmount = netTax<0 ? |netTax| : 0.
nodes.authority: ATO: LITO/SAPTO are non-refundable (reduce to $0); franking credits (Div 207) are refundable
nodes.workedExample: gross $1,000 + LITO $700 → netTax $300; gross $500 + LITO $700 → netTax $0 (non-refundable floor); gross $0 + franking $1,000 → netTax −$1,000, refundable $1,000

nodes.label: Medicare levy (2% + shade-in)
nodes.produces: MedicareLevyResult { medicareLevy, medicareSurcharge, total, isShadeIn }.
nodes.formula: Below threshold → 0; shade-in (threshold..125%) → 10% of excess over threshold; above shade-out → full 2% of taxable income. Exempt/≤0 → 0.
nodes.authority: Medicare Levy Act 1986; ATO Medicare Levy

nodes.produces: Weighted sum of 0-100 category scores by category weight, less penalty modifiers, clamped to 0-100 and rounded.
nodes.formula: score = round(clamp(0,100, Σ(catScore×catWeight) − totalPenalty))
nodes.authority: Monitrax health methodology (Phase 12 Financial Health Engine)

nodes.label: Financial health score

nodes.label: CFO overall score (weighted)
nodes.produces: The 0-100 CFO score from the 6 weighted component sub-scores (Decimal sibling).
nodes.formula: overall = Σ(component × SCORE_WEIGHTS[component]) over the 6 components (cashflowStrength .25 + debtCoverage .20 + emergencyBuffer .15 + investmentDiversification .15 + spendingControl .15 + savingsRate .10).
nodes.authority: Monitrax CFO-score methodology (6 weighted components: cashflow 25% / debt 20% / emergency 15% / diversification 15% / spending 15% / savings 10%)

nodes.label: CFO score (orchestrator)
nodes.produces: CFOScore { overall, components, trend } — the §6.4 CFO SSOT.
nodes.formula: Fetches data → calculateComponents → Math.round(Σ component × weight) (:64-71) → trend. The displayed CFO Score.
nodes.authority: Monitrax CFO-score methodology (6 weighted components: cashflow 25% / debt 20% / emergency 15% / diversification 15% / spending 15% / savings 10%)

nodes.label: CFO score component weights
nodes.produces: The 6-component CFO weighting (sums to 1.0): cashflow 25%, debt 20%, emergency 15%, diversification 15%, spending 15%, savings 10%.
nodes.formula: overall = Σ component_i × weight_i
nodes.authority: Monitrax CFO methodology (Phase 17 Personal CFO Engine)

nodes.label: CFO score

nodes.label: /dashboard/cfo — CFO score
nodes.produces: Renders the CFO score.

nodes.label: What-if: cut a spend category
nodes.produces: ScenarioResult — monthly cashflow + annual saving + savings-rate + emergency-months impact of cutting a category.
nodes.formula: realisedReduction = min(monthlyReduction, currentCategorySpend); annual saving = realisedReduction × 12; monthlyCashflowAfter = before + realisedReduction.
nodes.authority: Monitrax what-if methodology (annual = monthly delta × 12, held constant 12 months; reduction capped at actual spend)

nodes.label: What-if annualisation rule
nodes.produces: What-if scenarios annualise a monthly delta as delta × 12 (assumes the change holds constant for 12 months); reductions/inputs are capped at the actual underlying amount.
nodes.formula: annual = monthlyDelta × 12

nodes.label: Cashflow health score (5-category)
nodes.produces: CashflowHealthScore — overall 0-100 + per-category breakdown (liquidity/stability/forecast/budget/debt).
nodes.formula: overall = round(Σ categoryScore × CATEGORY_WEIGHTS); weights liquidity .25 / cashflowStability .25 / forecastRisk .20 / budgetAdherence .15 / debtHealth .15. Stability: surplusRatio≥.20→100 / ≥.10→80 / ≥.05→60 / ≥0→40 / else max(0,40+ratio×200), minus volatility penalty min(20, volatilityIndex×0.2), plus savings bonus min(10, savingsRate×0.5).

nodes.label: GRDCS linkage health
nodes.produces: LinkageHealthResponse — completeness, orphan/missing counts, module breakdown, severity.
nodes.formula: orphanPct = orphans/totalEntities×100; missingPct = missing/totalEntities×100. Severity: orphanPct≥25→critical / (missingPct≥10 or orphanPct≥10)→high / (≥5)→warning / else healthy.
nodes.authority: Monitrax GRDCS linkage-health Blueprint thresholds (§04 GRDCS)

nodes.label: Cashflow health category weights
nodes.produces: 5-category weighting (sums to 1.0): liquidity .25, cashflowStability .25, forecastRisk .20, budgetAdherence .15, debtHealth .15.
nodes.formula: overall = Σ category × weight

nodes.label: GRDCS linkage severity thresholds
nodes.produces: Severity: ≥25% orphans → critical; ≥10% missing or orphans → high; ≥5% → warning; else healthy.
nodes.formula: severity = f(orphanPct, missingPct) by Blueprint thresholds

nodes.label: Property portfolio report
nodes.produces: Report sections: portfolio metrics (total value/equity/purchase, capital growth + growth%, avg LVR, count) + tax benefits.
nodes.formula: totalValue = Σ currentValue; totalPurchase = Σ purchasePrice; capitalGrowth = totalValue − totalPurchase; growth% = round(capitalGrowth/totalPurchase×100); avgLVR = Σ lvr / n.
nodes.authority: Standard property-portfolio metrics (report aggregation of canonical per-property values)

nodes.label: Report aggregation rules
nodes.produces: Reports aggregate the canonical per-entity values (Σ for totals; growth% = (value−cost)/cost×100; averages = Σ/n) — they re-present, never re-derive differently from the canonical engines (§12.2).
nodes.formula: total = Σ value; growth% = (value−cost)/cost×100; avg = Σ/n
nodes.authority: Monitrax reporting methodology + §12.2 SSOT (reports consume canonical values)

nodes.label: Loan/debt aggregation (interest)
nodes.produces: LoanAggregation — totalPrincipal, totalRepayments, totalInterest, weightedInterestRate, byType. The §6.2 debt SSOT.
nodes.formula: monthly interest = principal × (interestRateAnnual / 12) [interestRateAnnual is a DECIMAL 0.0625 = 6.25%]; annual = ×12. weightedInterestRate = Σ(principal×rate)/Σprincipal. repayments via toMonthly/toAnnual.
nodes.authority: Standard interest = principal × annual rate; CLAUDE.md §19.2 (interestRateAnnual decimal — the prior 100× bug, P0-fixed 2026-06-23)
nodes.verifiedBy: tests/neomatrix/financialAudit.test.ts (A1 law-referenced — locks the 100× class) + lib/calculations/loanAggregator.ts:69

nodes.label: Declared expense aggregation
nodes.produces: ExpenseAggregation — total, essential, discretionary, taxDeductible, byCategory. The §6.2 expense SSOT.
nodes.formula: total = Σ toMonthly(amount, frequency) (or toAnnual); essential/discretionary by isEssential; taxDeductible by isTaxDeductible.

nodes.label: Declared income aggregation (gross / net / PAYG)
nodes.produces: IncomeAggregation — grossTotal, netTotal, paygWithholding, byType, taxableIncome, nonTaxableIncome. The §6.2 income SSOT.
nodes.formula: grossTotal = Σ getGrossAmount(item, target); net = Σ getNetAmount; payg = Σ getPaygAmount. SALARY+NET uses grossAmount (already ANNUAL, /12 for monthly); SALARY+GROSS uses amount×freq; non-salary uses amount×freq. paygWithholding is already-annual (/12 for monthly). taxableIncome splits on isTaxable !== false.

inputs.name: salaryType + grossAmount/netAmount
inputs.note: SALARY GROSS vs NET: grossAmount/netAmount are ALREADY-ANNUAL (asymmetric with amount which uses frequency)

inputs.name: paygWithholding
inputs.note: already-annual; /12 for monthly target; only SALARY type

nodes.workedExample: SALARY GROSS $120k/yr + rental $2k/mo → grossTotal $12,000/mo; PAYG $30k → $2,500/mo; SALARY NET grossAmount $100k (annual target) → grossTotal $100,000

nodes.label: Loan interest = principal × annual rate
nodes.produces: Monthly interest = principal × (annual rate / 12); annual = principal × annual rate. The rate is a decimal fraction.
nodes.formula: monthlyInterest = P × r/12
